svg.title: Planisphere against four historical star catalogues
svg.desc: Left: recorded against modelled stellar motion for Ptolemy and Hevelius. Right: scatter of longitude and latitude residuals for the four catalogues on a log scale.
svg.text: Stellar motion seen in the old observations
Per star: shift recorded vs shift modelled by planisphere (arcmin, both axes)
Dashed line: recorded = modelled. 72 points beyond +/-40 not drawn.
Scatter of the residuals, by catalogue
Robust sigma of planisphere minus recorded (arcmin, log scale)
planisphere vs the editors' own reduction: 0.04
